portal_summary: An updated nautilus package that fixes a bug is now available.

portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure that all previously-released
errata relevant to your system have been applied.

This update is available via Red Hat Network.  Details on how to use
the Red Hat Network to apply this update are available at
http://kbase.redhat.com/faq/FAQ_58_10188
portal_description:
Nautilus is a file manager which integrates access to files, applications,
media, and Internet-based resources. It is a core component of the GNOME
desktop project.

Excess redraws caused a delay between right-clicking on the desktop and the
contextual menu appearing. This was especially evident on large displays:
for example monitors with diagonal viewable image lengths of 760mm (30").
In this updated package, excess redraws have been removed, which resolves
this issue.

All Nautilus users are advised to upgrade to this updated package, which
resolves this issue.
